summary: Encore Capital Group issued $325 million aggregate principal amount of senior secured floating rate notes due 2033 under an indenture dated May 28, 2026. The notes bear interest at three-month EURIBOR + 3.250% per annum, reset quarterly, with quarterly payments beginning July 15, 2026, and mature July 15, 2033. The notes are senior secured obligations, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by substantially all material subsidiaries, and secured by substantially all assets of the company and guarantors. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
